page.layout: One page of text in a single column; margin notes at left, cut off and mostly illegible at the gutter edge; a catchword at lower right.

main_text.p: quos inspicere operæ pretium fuerit. Huic finem tandem dedit sive invidia Romanorum, sive metus ex ea, quòd quiescere non posse, &, si instauratis viribus bis jam difficili & diuturno bello victa denuò se commoveret, in extremum periculum res Romanas adducere posse crederetur, sive injuria contra pacis leges Masinissæ regi vicino, Romanorum socio ac amico, illata. Hinc quidem belli postremi prætextus sumptus. Rectè verò dicit Strabo, ex ipso ejuscę excidio verè patuisse, quanta Carthago fuerit, & dicti sui rationes dilucidas adfert. Hoc certè constat, opibus non imparem Romæ prioribus bellis fuisse, sed solâ virtute ei cessisse, nec ul[illegible, ~3 letters]lam civitatem liberam, non Græcam, [illegible, ~3 letters]barbaram, exceptâ tantum Româ, [illegible, ~3 letters]us terrâ marique imperasse, nec [illegible, ~3 letters]m rei militaris majorem multo tem-[illegible, ~3 letters][?]re[?] habuisse. Quapropter Romani cum exscindere eam statuissent, præter morem suum, astu magis quàm aperto Marte rem sunt aggressi. Nam conscripto celeriter ingenti exercitu, & addito apparatu maximo in Siciliam eum cum utroque consule secretis mandatis instructo misere, & simul bellum Carthaginì denunciarunt. Ea re vehementer perculsi Carthaginienses, nondum tum sanatis

page.notes: Left margin: the marginal notes are cut off at the left edge of the scan and show only fragments (for example "ram," and partial letters beside the lines "fuisse", "iam civitatem", "barbaram", "rei militaris" and "cum exscindere"). They are unreadable and are marked as illegible. The first word of the page is a continuation from the previous page. Long s has been written as s throughout; real f is kept where it occurs. The "tem-[?]re" line break is uncertain because the first letter after the hyphen is damaged. The catchword "sanatis" is at lower right below the last line; the text itself ends with "tum". "Masinissæ" is read from "Mafiniflæ" with long s mapped to s.
